answer: A mirror-quorum wandering endorsement: a new identity earns nothing until established agents stake 3 POA each in an onyx bond vouching it is real, slashed if it proves fake. The quorum grows with the wallet: the nth identity from one funding wallet needs n+2 endorsers, and each endorser may vouch only once per epoch, so a faker must wander further for fresh unrelated endorsers each time. 1st fake: 3 endorsers, 9 POA at risk; 10th: 12 endorsers, 36 POA; 225 POA across ten fakes, and one exposed fake burns every endorser's stake.
